q: Matter is composed of atoms which are very small in _____.
e: Matter is composed of atoms which are very small in size. The physics in this sentence is built around size. Mass: the quantity of matter, a scalar that does not depend on location.

q: An atom consists of a core called the nucleus around which the particles called _____ are moving in orbits.
e: An atom consists of a core called the nucleus around which the particles called electrons are moving in orbits. Z counts protons. A counts protons plus neutrons. Electrons orbit outside.

q: An electron is a negatively charged particle having a charge of _____.
e: An electron is a negatively charged particle having a charge of $-1.6 \times 10^{-19}$ C. The physics in this sentence is built around $-1.6 \times 10^{-19}$ C.

q: The nucleus consists of two kinds of particles called proton and _____.
e: The nucleus consists of two kinds of particles called proton and neutron. Neutron here means the uncharged nucleon inside the nucleus. Electron: the negative particle that orbits the nucleus.

q: A proton is a _____ charged particle and a neutron is an uncharged particle.
e: A proton is a positively charged particle and a neutron is an uncharged particle. The physics in this sentence is built around positively.

q: In a normal atom, the number of orbiting electrons is always equal to the number of _____.
e: In a normal atom, the number of orbiting electrons is always equal to the number of protons. The physics in this sentence is built around protons.

q: A normal atom has no net charge. It is said to be electrically _____.
e: A normal atom has no net charge. It is said to be electrically neutral. The physics in this sentence is built around neutral.

q: If an atom gains one or more electrons, it carries a _____ charge.
e: If an atom gains one or more electrons, it carries a negative charge. The physics in this sentence is built around negative involving electrons.

q: If an atom loses one or more electrons, it becomes _____ charged.
e: If an atom loses one or more electrons, it becomes positively charged. The physics in this sentence is built around positively involving electrons.

q: When an atom becomes a charged atom, it is called an _____.
e: When an atom becomes a charged atom, it is called an ion. Ion names when an atom becomes a charged atom, it involving charged.

q: The nucleus has a net _____ charge.
e: The nucleus has a net neutral charge. Z counts protons. A counts protons plus neutrons. Electrons orbit outside.

q: The magnitude of positive charge of the nucleus is equal to the sum of the positive charges of all the _____ present in the nucleus.
e: The magnitude of positive charge of the nucleus is equal to the sum of the positive charges of all the protons present in the nucleus. Z counts protons. A counts protons plus neutrons. Electrons orbit outside.

q: An electron and a proton have the same _____ of electric charge.
e: An electron and a proton have the same magnitude of electric charge. The physics in this sentence is built around magnitude involving same.
